name: JustifyEnum
description: Enumeration of justify content values for UI elements.

staticFields.label: FlexStart
staticFields.description: FlexStart: aligns items to the start of the main axis.

staticFields.label: Center
staticFields.description: Center: aligns items to the center of the main axis.

staticFields.label: FlexEnd
staticFields.description: FlexEnd: aligns items to the end of the main axis.

staticFields.label: SpaceBetween
staticFields.description: SpaceBetween: distributes items evenly with space between them.

staticFields.label: SpaceAround
staticFields.description: SpaceAround: distributes items evenly with space around them.

staticFields.label: SpaceEvenly
staticFields.description: SpaceEvenly: distributes items evenly with equal space around them.
